title: Fragrant sisterhood, Floey, Atty, Tiny
html_source:
From the last chapter (Nausicca), Bloom remembers:
“At Dolphin’s barn charades in Luke Doyle’s house. Mat Dillon and his bevy of daughters: Tiny, Atty, Floey, Maimy, Louy, Hetty.”
